# Research map

## formats

- [`formats/INDEX.md`](formats/INDEX.md): Router to the format specs, concept notes and `.ksy` schemas: catalog of each format's magic, role, tier, spec and schema, the runtime asset graph, and community provenance.
- [`formats/all.md`](formats/all.md): `.ALL` bundle from `MAKEONE.EXE` ([FMT-ALL-CHUNKS]): u16 count, id table, u32 offsets with EOF sentinel, id ranges, palettes 0x8042 and 0x801E; shipped-game chunks are unchanged `.RES`/`.SMP` items.
- [`formats/flm.md`](formats/flm.md): `.FLM` film stream ([FMT-FLM-OPCODES]): FILM magic, 3-byte slice header (back-pointer, 50 Hz `tick_duration`), end-of-film epilogue, and opcodes create, interp, var_set, view_obj, credits, sound.
- [`formats/res.md`](formats/res.md): `.RES` archive ([FMT-RES-HEADER]): RS magic, `res_index` and `item_count` bytes, u32 offset table; prop archives carry a name table, scenery archives do not; compound keys and the index catalog.
- [`formats/sod-opcode-coverage.md`](formats/sod-opcode-coverage.md): Census work queue for Partial SOD shapes: `OP_ANIMATE` is drawn as sprites since #222 (the census no longer stops on it); two-vertex polygons, which stopped 7 more, are now drawn as lines; the films placing them, why seven side-view items export no whole model, and regeneration.
- [`formats/sod-opcodes.md`](formats/sod-opcodes.md): The 107-opcode `.SOD` table ([FMT-SOD-OPCODES]) dispatched as multiples of 9, the `OP_TAP`, `OP_ANIMATE` and `IFVIS`/`BVIS` facing-flag semantics, and si-tools readings kept as hypotheses.
- [`formats/sod.md`](formats/sod.md): `.SOD` model bytecode ([FMT-SOD-HEADER]): 0x000C magic, 10-byte header, power-of-two scale table (indices 18 and 19 seen in corpus), VM overview, coplanar decal rule, `OP_IFVIS` as a facing gate.

## formats/auxiliary

- [`formats/auxiliary/anchorpt.md`](formats/auxiliary/anchorpt.md): `ANCHORPT.DAT` ([FMT-MAP-ANCHORPT]): 1,024 28-byte anchor records saved by `SD.EXE`, elevation stored negated; the game images hold the 231 authored records, and the eleven words are inferred cache.
- [`formats/auxiliary/map.md`](formats/auxiliary/map.md): `MAP.BIN` ([FMT-MAP-AREA]) patch pool and `REGIONS.BIN` block tree from `SD.EXE`: fields as list links and split distance, how `SD.EXE` compiles them into the scenery tree, eight unlinked patches.
- [`formats/auxiliary/pfont.md`](formats/auxiliary/pfont.md): `PFONT.BIN`: 1,152-byte font of a 128-byte width table and 128 8x8 one-bit glyphs, and the `PLAYONE.EXE` credits rule (centring, ink 255, shadow) that reproduces the `INTRO.FLM` title cards.
- [`formats/auxiliary/scenery.md`](formats/auxiliary/scenery.md): `SCENERY.scn` ([FMT-MAP-SCENERY]) is `PLAYONE.EXE`'s stack-segment scenery tree widened to 32-bit words; node types, the `SP_1NODE` level-of-detail rule, and prop height: ancestors' `SP_POS` `y` plus the shape's `ground_y_offset` scaled by its scale index.
- [`formats/auxiliary/set.md`](formats/auxiliary/set.md): `.SET` stage ([FMT-SET-HEADER]): 84-byte header, 67-byte event records from 0x54, 64-byte prop records; `TYPESET.EXE` event operator codes; size formula closes on 129 sets, prop field map open.
- [`formats/auxiliary/sio.md`](formats/auxiliary/sio.md): `.SIO` SLICE modeller format ([FMT-SIO-RECORDS]): `Sds` magic, grid byte, 0x12 vertex and 0x06 midpoint records, `FF FF 00 00` trailer; the tool compiling `.SIO` to `.SOD` is unidentified.
- [`formats/auxiliary/spr.md`](formats/auxiliary/spr.md): `.SPR` sprite ([FMT-SPR-HEADER]): u16 width and height, row-major palette indices with colour 0 transparent, zero trailer word (size W*H+6), and the `MAKESPR` `.SOD` billboard wrapper.

## formats/concepts

- [`formats/concepts/compression.md`](formats/concepts/compression.md): DOS storage tiers: LZEXE 0.91 packing of `PLAYONE.EXE` and its LZSS bitstream, uncompressed retail `.RES` and `.ALL` payloads, PCX RLE in sprite sources, and the [I8] uppercase 8.3 path rules.
- [`formats/concepts/coordinates-and-units.md`](formats/concepts/coordinates-and-units.md): [I1] coordinate frames from model to screen: right-handed metric basis, 16.16 fixed point, BAM angles, `sod_scale_table`, editor units to metres, focal length and FOV, attribute-keyed vertex welding.
- [`formats/concepts/palette-and-shading.md`](formats/concepts/palette-and-shading.md): [I3] palette model: three 6-to-8-bit DAC scalings, palettes 0x8042 and 0x801E, colour groups and 32-level ramps, CTRY capture evidence against a sun-derived shade, sky bands 227-238, 256x32 LUT.
- [`formats/concepts/timeline-and-ticks.md`](formats/concepts/timeline-and-ticks.md): [I4] playback timing: 50 Hz PIT divisor 0x5D38, slice ticks as cumulative `tick_duration`, lerp and slerp sub-tick interpolation, shorter-arc roll, cut suppression, and 0x9C audio cues.

## formats/memory

- [`formats/memory/kaitai-memory-spike.md`](formats/memory/kaitai-memory-spike.md): Whether runtime memory records fit `.ksy`: `actor_record.ksy`, for the hypothesised [MEM-ACTOR-TABLE] layout, compiles and parses; `.ksy` is advised as layout source and check, not runtime parser.

## makeone-exe

- [`makeone-exe/driving.md`](makeone-exe/driving.md): How the harness drives `MAKEONE.EXE` under emulation to make a film's `.ALL`: keys, text-mode return as completion signal, a working mount, output checks, run time per CPU profile and hang policy.
- [`makeone-exe/linking.md`](makeone-exe/linking.md): A film's `.ALL` copies stock items verbatim, id-ordered by `(res_index << 8) | (segment + 1)`, music and common sounds by sound setting; stock shapes draw CTRY, INTRO and BALLOON like their archives in our renderer; on `PLAYONE` a superset with the palette items keeps the palettes, but some pages differ, as they do when the own archive is padded with inert chunks.

## parity

- [`parity/attribution.md`](parity/attribution.md): Splits the CTRY.FLM and INTRO.FLM SSIM loss by render layer: props are the largest class once ground tiles are decals, and a pre-decal CTRY window study puts most loss at edges, not flat colour.
- [`parity/batch-vault-films.md`](parity/batch-vault-films.md): Reads the ten retail vault films through the batch survey: the vision-model error readout, their render-store scores and capture rates, and the suspects rescored on the stride plan.
- [`parity/batch.md`](parity/batch.md): Survey of corpus films through `mise run batch-parity`'s archive, capture, render and score stages: the score spread of the 79 of 529 scored when it stopped, stage costs, capture failures, rescores.
- [`parity/col3-2-studio.md`](parity/col3-2-studio.md): Records the COL3-2.FLM studio interior (anchorman, desk, window) that PLAYONE draws from tick 458 and we do not: evaluator state, actor clusters, shape census, and why the gap is unresolved.
- [`parity/evidence-limits.md`](parity/evidence-limits.md): Lists what the parity scores do not yet establish: film coverage, metric caveats, the non-deterministic reference, GPU and lavapipe differences, and what dosbox-automation captures can and cannot show.
- [`parity/film-segments.md`](parity/film-segments.md): Covers INTRO.FLM segments where PLAYONE shows a scene we do not: sand shots as SCENERY tiles, the montage clock and parked aircraft, and black title cards. The COL3-2 studio is in col3-2-studio.md.
- [`parity/framing-and-actors.md`](parity/framing-and-actors.md): Records the camera and projection corrections tried against the capture: square 256 px projection (adopted) and the eye-height, pitch, FOV, framing-offset and tick-phase sweeps that were ruled out.
- [`parity/hero-aircraft-orientation.md`](parity/hero-aircraft-orientation.md): Records the actor orientation fixes for the CTRY.FLM hero aircraft: DOS rotation order, shapes that decode upside down, and the 48 axis-permutation sweep that ruled out other composition orders.
- [`parity/hero-aircraft-placement.md`](parity/hero-aircraft-placement.md): Records where the CTRY.FLM hero aircraft (shape 0x7F37) sits and how its body draws: position re-measures, SORTON subtrees, SHADE colour, ground offset, mesh vertices; the residual is open.
- [`parity/hero-shadow.md`](parity/hero-shadow.md): Records the actor ground shadow: the black silhouette the capture draws, where PLAYONE draws it from (slot flag, 0x19FC plane solve), the flattened-copy rule adopted in #206, and the open plane and cutoff questions.
- [`parity/lavapipe.md`](parity/lavapipe.md): On lavapipe, large near-eye ground polygons can draw palette index 0, inferred to come from a 0/0 clipper weight on `noperspective` varyings; a non-finite shade guard brings scores near the GPU's.
- [`parity/method.md`](parity/method.md): Defines the parity loop that judges a render change against PLAYONE.EXE: capture, render, SSIM and IoU scoring with the fade floor, compare verdicts, dead ends and how to read the legacy parity log.
- [`parity/metric-bench.md`](parity/metric-bench.md): Records how the parity metrics behave: the planted-fault metric bench, recapture noise of the reference films (with and without sound), and error categories graded by a vision model.
- [`parity/probes.md`](parity/probes.md): Procedures for diagnosing one parity discrepancy: `parity_probe.py` crop, shift, iou and retime, `DBG_` switch sweeps via `mise run sweep`, capture-side experiments, and environment pitfalls.
- [`parity/render-model.md`](parity/render-model.md): Compares PLAYONE's back-to-front software painter with our depth-buffer renderer stage by stage, naming each known divergence and the `[I5]` and ground-decal rules that imitate its tie order.
- [`parity/report-fields.md`](parity/report-fields.md): The keys and JSON types of the parity reports `report.json` and `compare.json`, checked against `stuntreel parity` output on synthetic fixtures by the `report_doc.rs` test.

## playone-exe

- [`playone-exe/capture-dosbox-automation.md`](playone-exe/capture-dosbox-automation.md): dosbox-automation 0.85.1 as capture emulator: frame-locked capture reading `film_tick` per frame at `DS = 0x0F46`, bit-identical `CTRY.FLM` runs with the demo archive, replays made to differ by sound samples in the archive, torn pages, DAC lag and the Lua instruction budget.
- [`playone-exe/capture-speed.md`](playone-exe/capture-speed.md): Historical DOSBox-X tests on `vault-balloon`: no tried setting, `turbo` or sampling cuts the 0.25 s frame cost, `nosound` freezes the clock, sampled tags lag 7 to 10 ticks; and where a capture ends.
- [`playone-exe/capture.md`](playone-exe/capture.md): Historical DOSBox-X debugger capture harness: link framing, crash constraints, BDA key injection, the `film_tick` tagging protocol, the one-tick page lag and an inferred 185-row 3D viewport.
- [`playone-exe/debugger-plans.md`](playone-exe/debugger-plans.md): How `mise run debug-x` breakpoint plans run on DOSBox-X: boot and key entry, image offset to live `CS:IP` mapping on both builds, the `BPM` watch filter that names a writer, and the hit loop.
- [`playone-exe/dosbox-x-legacy.md`](playone-exe/dosbox-x-legacy.md): What the retired DOSBox-X harness established, for reading old captures: link framing, debugger verbs and quirks, crash constraints, `DS = 0x1575`, late wall-paced tags and `dacexpand` rounding.
- [`playone-exe/lod.md`](playone-exe/lod.md): The `SP_1NODE` distance gate at `0x2121` compares half the view-space depth, shifted right by the lens exponent `0x229E`, with a threshold scaled by `DS:0x22A4` (the `GAME.VAR` detail word times the lens mantissa); Patch #3 runs the same gate code; the renderer tests it per frame, and captures likely run at full detail.
- [`playone-exe/memory-map.md`](playone-exe/memory-map.md): Offset tables for `PLAYONE.EXE` `DGROUP` and the SOD VM work segment on the unpatched and Patch #3 builds, defining most [MEM-*] anchors, such as [MEM-FLM-TICK], [MEM-SOD-VM] and [MEM-PALETTE].
- [`playone-exe/memory.md`](playone-exe/memory.md): Evidence for the memory map: `DS` per emulator, the [MEM-FLM-TICK] counters (film clock read equal to `0x22B8` until it holds), the unverified `0C5E` trap, [MEM-UNPACK-LOCKOUT] and image relocation.
- [`playone-exe/navigation.md`](playone-exe/navigation.md): How the `PLAYONE.EXE` LOAD FILM dialog works: a `VAULT` directory listbox with single-letter prefix jumps, `.FLM`/`.ALL` pairing, and harness key injection through the BIOS keyboard ring buffer.
- [`playone-exe/palette-fade.md`](playone-exe/palette-fade.md): Film variables 13-15, keyed by `var_set` and interpolated per frame, drive the palette build at `0x0FD2` (night, brightness, saturation), so the end-of-film fade is authored in the film.
- [`playone-exe/patch3.md`](playone-exe/patch3.md): What Patch #3 changes, the patched `PLAYONE.EXE` offsets mapped by function pairing (one dispatch slot fewer, inferred statically), and which build each tested film needs to play and capture.
- [`playone-exe/sod-animate.md`](playone-exe/sod-animate.md): `OP_ANIMATE` (`0x01F8`) blits frame `(count × bank word) >> 16` of its image table as a square centred on a projected point; selector `0x16` is the slot's interpolated `.FLM` animate word, `0x10` the film clock.
- [`playone-exe/sod-vm.md`](playone-exe/sod-vm.md): The SOD display-list VM: self-patching dispatch slots, `OP_TAP` encoding and anchor loading [FMT-SOD-TAP], the execution model with its facing and depth gates and the model frame of every raw-coordinate generator, two-vertex polygons and `ZLINETO` lines as one-pixel lines, the per-frame draw with credits, and a candidate actor shadow path.
- [`playone-exe/startup.md`](playone-exe/startup.md): `PLAYONE.EXE` startup: LZEXE 0.91 packing, a command tail that honours only `?` (runs `install.exe`), the `game.cfg`, memory and disk checks, asset paths, and how to reproduce the static analysis.
- [`playone-exe/static-tooling.md`](playone-exe/static-tooling.md): Which static tool answers which `PLAYONE.EXE` question (`mise run disasm`/`xref`/`vm-handler`, Ghidra, rea), what Ghidra cannot see in the VM handlers, and the address coordinate conversions.
- [`playone-exe/terrain-shade.md`](playone-exe/terrain-shade.md): `GVPOLY`/`GVPOLY16` shade as a Gouraud ramp on the palette index (`SHADES` term, `idx = base + (s >> 9)`, screen-space fill), lit by the world light the var-13 handler writes; the ground does not.
- [`playone-exe/world-scene.md`](playone-exe/world-scene.md): `PLAYONE` draws the ground flat from `MAP.BIN`-coloured leaves of a BSP scenery tree in its own image and, in live CTRY runs, paints `SCENERY2.RES` tiles over it, licensing our ground-decal pass.

## research

- [`handbook.md`](handbook.md): Source card for the retail handbook and its OCR text: how to cite it, why it is reliable for structure but not for numbers or units, its [Hypothesis] ceiling, and where each finding went.

## sd-exe

- [`sd-exe/image.md`](sd-exe/image.md): Reading the `SD.EXE` scenery designer image: MZ header and load-image offset rule, segments and DGROUP, string offsets, and routines for `ANCHORPT.DAT`, `MAP.BIN` and the `REGIONS.BIN` block tree.

## stunt-exe

- [`stunt-exe/sets.md`](stunt-exe/sets.md): `STUNT.EXE` evidence on `.SET`: neither `MAKEONE` nor `PLAYONE` names it, its display templates give the IF/AND/THEN vocabulary with operand widths; also the crack stub and TYPESET as dump oracle.
